answer: Reusing one run across aliases collides on the karst identifier and voids the later submissions, and as a result the operator burns for 294 runs and collects one. Because the relic index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the ridge audit republishes the full set. Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 294 answers need 294 separate inference runs with separate seeds. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
